run_ocr_predictor: run the PDFScannedPredictor to classify a PDF as scanned or text-based using an XGBoost model
extract_pdf_features: extract document-level and page-level features from a PDF document using PDFFeatureExtractor
flatten_page_features: flatten per-page list-based PDF features into a single flat feature dictionary for model input
merge_image_strips: merge vertically or horizontally aligned full-page image strips on a PDF page using heuristic bounding box rules
check_garbled_text: compute the ratio of garbled replacement characters to total text length per page in a PDF document
